newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks 1.14 pct up on speculative buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks 1.14 pct up on speculative buying.

text.p: Pakistani stocks jumped 1.14 percent on Wednesday mainly on speculative buying though profit-taking by speculators trimmed early gains on the new accounts day.

"The index lost over 125 points in five straight sessions, it was time for some recovery," dealer Shakeel Anwar at Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) said. "But the early gains were trimmed as individuals booked profits."
Speculators bought select synthetic, cement and financial stocks because of attractive levels, dealers said. But there was little demand from genuine investors.
The KSE index rose 18.38 points to end at 1,635.55. Gainers beat losers 162 to 124 as turnover rose to 57.41 million shares from 40.05 million on Tuesday.
Engro Chemicals rose 6.0 rupees to 180, Sui Southern Gas 0.25 to 29.50 and Fauji Cement 0.45 to 10.80. Hub Power Co fell 0.30 to 39.60 and PTCL 0.45 to 30.80.
